title: Best music experience in Barcelona
text: It is a great experience! Definitely the best music and most fun drink and sea you can have in Barcelona.
author: Vacation258691

title: Wonderful and highly recommended.
text:
Thank you very much! I had a great time; I went with some friends and we enjoyed a lot. We were looking for a different plan at a good price to disconnect, and we definitely made the right choice.
The service was excellent, the staff very friendly and attentive at all times, ensuring that we were all well; the ride was smooth and calm, no one got seasick, and the drinks were all very tasty and reasonably priced. We will definitely repeat more often.
author: Natalia B

title: The crew.
text: The experience was unique; the atmosphere with the music adds a special touch, and the crew was very attentive and helpful.
author: Freedom576776

title: Unforgettable experience
text:
We went to the Sunset outing with my partner. Good music, we sailed, delicious cocktails, and a very attentive and professional crew. 
If I had to mention one downside, it would be that the experience felt short because we had such a great time!

title: A dream afternoon
text: It was a very pleasant experience, the phenomenal walk and the excellent crew attention. We enjoyed great music and a dreamy sunset. 100% recommended.
author: P1503RBrosanaf

title: Overall, this was a...
text:
Overall, this was a good-value and relaxing catamaran experience. The departure location at Port Olímpic was very convenient, and the two-hour tour included one free drink and some light snacks, which was a nice touch. For the price, I thought it offered great value for money.

The main downside was the route. I had expected more time actually sailing along the Barcelona coastline, but around two-thirds of the trip was spent slowly drifting around inside or very close to the harbour. That portion became a little boring after a while and felt like a missed opportunity given the beautiful coastl
author: KatelynG
